signer.title: Signer
signer.description: Patient, or DecisionMaker when the patient cannot decide

signer_name.title: Signer Name
signer_name.description: Default for the patient: their name

signer_relationship.title: Signer Relationship
signer_relationship.description: A decision maker: one the policy allows for this patient (GET /consent-decision-makers)

incapacity_reason.title: Incapacity Reason
incapacity_reason.description: Why the patient cannot decide (a decision maker or the emergency note)

witness_name.title: Witness Name
witness_name.description: Required for a thumb impression, a verbal refusal and the forms that say so

read_to_patient.title: Read To Patient
read_to_patient.description: The text was read aloud (the patient cannot read it)

questions_answers.title: Questions Answers
questions_answers.description: The questions asked and the answers given; "None asked" (required when signed)

understanding_confirmed.title: Understanding Confirmed
understanding_confirmed.description: The patient (or decision maker) explained it back in their own words (required when signed)

decided_at.title: Decided At
decided_at.description: When it was signed; default now, never in the future

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: EmergencyNote: nobody could consent and the treatment could not wait (a doctor writes it)

emergency_note.title: Emergency Note
emergency_note.description: Why the treatment could not wait and nobody could consent

second_doctor_id.title: Second Doctor Id
second_doctor_id.description: The second registered doctor who concurs with the emergency note (setting consent_emergency_second_doctor): an employee_id from GET /staff/lookup?license_type=PMDC
